messages:
Maya (RevOps): Heads-up — noticed a ~40% spike in unassigned inbound leads for APAC this morning. HubSpot -> SF handoff shows enrichment timeouts causing RR to skip. Can we quick-sync on mitigations?
Alec (Growth): ugh. saw a blip in the dashboard too. is this the enrichment debounce bug we patched last month?
Samir (Eng): Looks related but different pattern. Quick summary from logs: HS webhook retry 429/backoff, enrichment lambda timed out at 7s, fallback to RR noop which leaves lead unowned.
Jordan (Ops): leadbot alerted at 08:12UTC: "Unassigned-leads-rate > 3% for inbound pipeline - check enrichment" :warning:
Maya (RevOps): can we do a short rollout plan: 1) short-term default-owner fallback, 2) heartbeat probe to mark pending leads, 3) longer-term: add jitter/retry improvements in HS webhook.
Samir (Eng): agree. proposed tiny patch (canary to stage) — set default_owner when enrichment doesn't return in 3s. snippet: 
```json
{"webhook": {"timeout_ms": 3000, "fallback_owner": "tier1@company.com"}}
```
Alec (Growth): fallback owner is fine as a stopgap. but need SLAs updated so SDRs know it's fallback and not true assignment. will draft a banner and slack notify. :loudspeaker:
Jordan (Ops): for heartbeat probe, we can add a cron job that looks for leads in "pending_enrichment" > 10s and pokes them into RR with a low priority tag. simple pseudo: 
```
SELECT id FROM leads WHERE state='pending_enrichment' AND age_s>10
POST /routing/round_robin?priority=low
```
Maya (RevOps): good. also want to tune HubSpot workflow so enrichment TTL is explicit (3s/10s) and add a webhook header x-retry-count for observability.
Samir (Eng): will add x-retry-count. also propose exponential backoff config in HS webhook: initial=500ms, max=5s, attempts=4. will push PR for the retry lib.
Alec (Growth): can we add a metric: leads_assigned_after_fallback (to track churn/backfill)? want to measure how many fallback assignments get reassigned to correct owner within 24h.
Jordan (Ops): added to monitoring board. alert threshold: >2% fallback_assign_rate for >30m triggers oncall.
Maya (RevOps): test plan: 1) unit test for fallback_owner config, 2) staging canary for 2 hours with 10% traffic, 3) smoke test with synthetic HS events for slow enrichment, 4) communication to SDR: banner + playbook.
Samir (Eng): ok I'll open PR and tag @Maya for rollout checklist. aiming for canary today 18:00UTC.
Alec (Growth): I'll prep the banner + a one-pager on what fallback means for SLAs.
Maya (RevOps): perfect. post-rollout follow-ups: capture: sample of affected leads, conversion delta, and whether SF ownership mapping had any drift. 
leadbot: Incident note created: "HS enrichment latency - fallback enabled" id:INC-52901. :white_check_mark:
Jordan (Ops): thumbs up. if we hit weird edgecases I'll escalate. thanks team.
Maya (RevOps): great sync — follow-ups: Samir PR link, Alec banner draft, Jordan monitoring link. ping back here when PR is merged. :rocket:
